title: SpellUi::engine_task is an Option<Task> used as the 'engine build in flight' stage, cleared by hand in install_spell_engine
trigger: Pick a spelling language twice quickly in Appearance > Spelling: the second start_spell_engine drops the first task by overwrite; install clears the Option by hand
effect: None today (the task is dropped with the overwrite and install resets it); the stage is an Option kept in step with spell.info rather than one value
fix: enum EngineBuild { Idle, Building { chosen, _task } } owned by SpellUi, replaced whole on each start and on install

title: Media spoiler TileState::Building has no way out if the background build never answers
trigger: build_image_tile panics or the spawned task is cancelled with the app still alive: TILE stays Building
effect: Media spoiler specks never draw again for the session (cover still shows); text spoilers unaffected
fix: Building holds the task and a failure arm returns to Idle (or Failed) so the next frame can ask again

title: baseline: PickWait::Downloading holds a FileId and window but no request or task; the wait is ended by polling the download tracker each frame
trigger: Adapt/Add an existing sticker or GIF that is not downloaded: ask_pick_file sends downloadFile, the stage waits; sticker_box_window_upkeep polls local_media_path / ended_without_file in the host window's frame
effect: Works today (a failed download ends the wait with a note, a closed box or window ends it); a host window that never draws a frame (minimized chat window) leaves the wait until it draws
fix: Downloading { request: RequestId, .. } answered by the download ack, not polled from upkeep

title: SidebarReveal::wake (the grace-period redraw task) is a parallel field beside Mode, kept in step by set_mode, instead of living in Peek::Leaving
trigger: Pointer leaves the peeking sidebar: pointer_left sets Mode::Hidden(Leaving) and the caller then spawns the wake and hands it to hold_wake, which silently drops it if the mode is no longer Leaving
effect: None today (every set_mode resets the wake); a new transition that assigns self.mode directly would leave a stale wake or lose one
fix: Peek::Leaving { since, wake: Task<()> } so the task is dropped with the stage

title: ChartState::key_point and ChartState::pie are two Options that exclude each other by hand
trigger: Arrow keys pick a point (key_point), then a click zooms into the pie: enter_pie clears key_point by hand; step() and the key handler stay out of the pie only through `!pie` guards in the view
effect: None today; a new entry into the pie (or a step while in it) that forgets the other field would show a key readout over a pie

title: The story viewer's 100 ms tick redraws the overlay for as long as the viewer is open, also while paused, behind a panel or with the window inactive
trigger: Open a story, press Space (or switch to another app): ensure_story_tick keeps waking every 100 ms; story_playback_paused only gates playback, notify_story(cx) runs every wake
effect: 10 redraws a second of an overlay that shows nothing new (battery/CPU), until the viewer is closed
fix: Stop the tick (StoryTick::Off) while paused or inactive and start it on resume, or notify only when something on the overlay changed

title: A new download of a code can start while the cancelled worker of the same code is still running, both writing the same .{code}.{ext}.part temp files
trigger: Switch a downloading language off (Cancelling, worker past its last cancel check and inside spell_catalog::install), then switch it on again at once: start_dictionary_download only refuses Running, and install uses fixed temp names
effect: One of the two installs fails its rename ("Couldn't save the dictionary") or the files are interleaved; the list refreshes from disk afterwards
fix: Refuse (or queue) a new download while Cancelling, or give install a unique temp name per call

title: Export to File has no stage: pressing it twice before the save dialog answers opens two dialogs and writes two files
trigger: Click "Export to File" twice quickly on a statistics page; each press snapshots the sheets and spawns its own detached task awaiting prompt_for_new_path
effect: Two save dialogs in a row; a second toast overwrites the first
fix: enum Export { Idle, Choosing { _task } } on the statistics page state, held and dropped with the panel
